articles.title: Rupee Hits Seven-Month High At 93.69 Against US Dollar On FPI Inflows And Lower Crude Oil Prices
articles.description: The rupee strengthened to 93.69 against the US dollar, its strongest level since April, gaining 0.2% amid nearly $6 billion in foreign institutional inflows into Indian equities in November and softer crude prices. It remains down roughly 4% year-to-date, while analysts cite 94.10 resistance and 93.50 support.

articles.title: Govt Staff Cars To Go Electric As Finance Ministry Issues New EV Procurement Rules
articles.description: The Finance Ministry has made electric vehicles the default choice for central government staff cars, effective immediately. Ministries can procure EVs costing up to ₹20 lakh, compared with ₹10 lakh for petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles. Departments seeking conventional vehicles must obtain special approval.

articles.title: Saudi Oil Production Surges Back Towards Pre-War Levels as Global Energy Markets Shift

The recovery is reshaping global supply, easing pressure on oil prices and strengthening Riyadh’s influence over energy markets as geopolitical uncertainty continues across the Middle East. articles.title: Congo’s Oil Windfall Hides a Debt Trap That Could Undermine Growth and Jobs
articles.description: The Republic of Congo is projected to grow by 4.4% in 2026 as higher oil prices strengthen public finances, but the World Bank warns that persistent payment arrears and weak fiscal management could undermine the recovery. With oil revenues expected to lose momentum from 2027, the country faces a narrowing opportunity to break its debt cycle, restore private sector confidence and turn temporary financial gains into lasting, poverty-reducing growth.
